evals.prompt: Review this markdown documentation against Microsoft writing standards. Evaluate it across all 8 categories (clarity, conciseness, active voice, accessibility, heading hierarchy, task orientation, terminology consistency, Microsoft compliance) and provide a detailed review report.
evals.expected_output: review.json with category scores, overall score, line-by-line findings with severity levels, and suggested fixes. Each finding should include issue description, context from the document, and specific recommendations.

evals.prompt: Conduct a comprehensive quality review of this documentation. Generate both a JSON review with detailed findings and an HTML report suitable for sharing with stakeholders. Include severity classifications and actionable recommendations.
evals.expected_output: review.json (structured data) and review.html report with overall score, category results, findings table with severity indicators, and detailed sections per category with suggested fixes.

evals.prompt: Review this markdown for Microsoft style compliance. Identify any issues with clarity, active voice, terminology consistency, task orientation, and adherence to Microsoft writing guidelines. Provide recommendations for each issue found.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive review with findings organized by category and severity. Include line numbers, context snippets, specific issues, and suggested rewrites. Overall pass/fail for each category with numerical scores.
